mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives up S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and increasing S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops below 3.5% but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both employment and unemployment indicators improve, it signals a robust economy, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rise but SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases during tightening.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation as indicated by CPI leads to tighter monetary policy, negatively affecting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPI is high but SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production indicates strong economic activity, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO exceeds 110 but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both retail sales and housing starts increase, it signals strong consumer demand, boosting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both RSAFS and HOUST increase but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising unemployment signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises during late-cycle but SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
